preconditions.description: The input S must be a string.
The length of the input string S must not exceed 40 characters.

preconditions.expression: len(S) >= 8 if '@' in S else len(S) >= 10
preconditions.description: If S is an email address, it must have a length of at least 8; if it is a phone number, it must have a length of at least 10.

postconditions.description: If S is an email address, the output must be the lowercase version of S with the first name masked; if S is a phone number, the output must start with '***-***-' and end with the last 4 digits of S.
postconditions.expression: stdout == S.split('@')[0][0].lower() + '*****' + S.split('@')[0][-1].lower() + '@' + S.split('@')[1].lower() if '@' in S else stdout.startswith('***-***-') and stdout.endswith(S[-4:])

postconditions.description: If S is a phone number, it must contain only digits and the characters '+', '-', '(', ')', or ' '.
postconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() or c in '+-() ' for c in S) if not '@' in S else True

postconditions.description: If S is an email address, the output must have the first name masked with 5 asterisks between the first and last letter, and all names must be in lowercase.
postconditions.expression: stdout == S.split('@')[0][0].lower() + '*****' + S.split('@')[0][-1].lower() + '@' + S.split('@')[1].lower() if '@' in S else True

postconditions.description: If S is a phone number with a country code, the output must start with '+***-***-***-' followed by the last 4 digits of S.
postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('+***-***-***-') and stdout.endswith(S[-4:]) if not '@' in S and len(S) > 10 else True

postconditions.description: If S is a phone number without a country code, the output must be formatted as '***-***-1111' where 1111 represents the last 4 digits of S.
postconditions.expression: stdout == '***-***-' + S[-4:] if not '@' in S and len(S) == 10 else True
